title: End-to-end user testing of Field Notes: Android, then macOS

completion_criteria.text: Android journeys A1 to A15 from the plan each run on the Galaxy Note 10+ (RF8MA2NA3ZM) with a recorded result (pass, fail, or not run with the reason) and a screenshot path as evidence
completion_criteria.check: The report's Android table lists A1 to A15, each with a result and an existing screenshot file under the testkit results folder
completion_criteria.settled_by: Have the testing start with Android.

completion_criteria.text: Every Android defect found is recorded with the user-visible symptom, repro steps, severity (Blocks, Hurts or Cosmetic) and evidence, after ruling out harness artefacts
completion_criteria.check: Each entry in the report's Android defects section has steps, a severity and a screenshot path, and notes why it is not a harness artefact

completion_criteria.text: The owner's explicit permission is obtained before any macOS testing starts
completion_criteria.check: The session log quotes the owner's go-ahead, dated before the first macOS probe launch
completion_criteria.settled_by: Once complete, ask for permission to start the MacOS.

completion_criteria.text: macOS journeys M1 to M15 run with in-app input only and the watchdog armed for every unattended run; no system-wide input is injected at any point
completion_criteria.check: The report's macOS table lists M1 to M15 with results; every run's guard log shows GUARDING followed by ENDED or ABORTED; no System Events keystroke or HID-tap CGEvent appears in the scripts used

completion_criteria.text: The carried-forward macOS findings are re-checked by hand with screenshots: floated photo drag jumping to the note end, file-URL-only paste inserting nothing, and Ctrl+K doing nothing
completion_criteria.check: The report states confirmed or not reproduced for each of the three, with a screenshot

completion_criteria.text: A final report answers, per platform, whether a normal user can use the app: journey tables, defects ranked Blocks, Hurts, Cosmetic, and what was not tested and why
completion_criteria.check: The report is posted in chat and saved as ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/E2E-REPORT.md
completion_criteria.settled_by: The goal is to make sure if a normal user uses the application, will it work.

artifacts.label: End-to-end test plan (journeys, rules, known state, what worked and did not)
Android probe build patch (package rename, file_picker Kotlin workaround, keep screen on)
macOS probe native input patch (in-app NSEvent injection, input and pointer endpoints)
macOS driver harness fixes (also uncommitted in the working tree)

spine.active_goal: Verify, by driving the live app the way a normal user would, that every Field Notes feature works on the Galaxy Note 10+ (Android) and then on the Mac, and report defects ranked by user impact. Bounded by the journeys in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/E2E-TEST-PLAN.md, not by statistical gate counts or open-ended edge cases.
spine.next_step: Resume this thread, read ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/E2E-TEST-PLAN.md and README.md in full, then run Android setup A0: confirm adb sees RF8MA2NA3ZM, build and install the probe APK from a scratch worktree with patches/android-probe-build.patch applied, push three test photos, and ask the owner whether the harness may grant the probe's runtime permissions with pm grant before starting journey A1.

key_decisions.title: Live-test input never leaves the device under test
Normal-user journeys with small samples; Android first, macOS on permission
